description: Imports SSRS / Telerik RDL (Report Definition Language, an XML dialect) into the internal ReportDefinition model. The importer is namespace-agnostic: RDL elements are matched by their local name, so the SSRS 2008 / 2010 / 2016 schema namespaces (which differ only by year) and Telerik-namespaced RDL all parse where their element vocabulary overlaps.

members.name: Import
members.description: Imports an RDL document supplied as a UTF-8/UTF-16 XML string.
